Values: M = Mexacanthina lugubris, As = Acanthinucella spirata

Description: The number of whelks remaining in the cage from the previous survey. Used to track how closely actual density matches with desired density. May not always equal the number of whelks initially caged.
Values: Varies, but ideally 0, 1, 3, 6, 12, and 24 (Baja sites only). This value may differ from the individual count on the deployment date, as most plots did not contain whelks upon deployment. On all other days, the value was recorded at the beginning of the survey (as a reflection of how many whelks remained after the ~2 week period). This column was used for the running average to assess the "average" whelk presence within our plots.

Description: The number of whelks added to the cage on dates AFTER deployement. Should make the total whelks in the cage equal the desired density level.
